verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt is served at help.reclaim.ai and returns an indexed Markdown listing of help-center articles. Individual help articles are also available as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: llms.txt covers only the end-user help center (no developer/API docs), no OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), root docs .md endpoint 404s, no first-party documentation describing agent-oriented docs, no independent corroboration.
